text:
olivia: Pushing FP8 kernel enablement canary on h100 and l40s. Observed non-monotonic accuracy: AWQ small models drop at seq>2048 but int8 stable. Can reproduce locally only on l40s. Anyone seen this pattern?

sam: which canary id? model + quant pipeline?

olivia: canary: can-2026-03-20-olivia-03. model: orion-7b-awq-fp8-enabled. quant: AWQ with 4-bit tuning then fp8 runtime kernel. runtime flags:
```
USE_FP8=true
KV_EVICT=auto
TILING=dynamic
BATCH=auto
```
latency nominal on h100, but accuracy delta +3.7% on h100 and -1.9% on l40s on our eval set (squad-like QA).

bench-bot: perf summary for can-2026-03-20-olivia-03
- H100: p99 tokens 72ms, eval-emissions match baseline within 0.2% for most prompts
- L40S: p99 tokens 120ms, observed increased hallucination rate on long-prefix prompts

lee: suspect KV prefix handling + tile alignment on l40s. Try forcing `KV_PREFETCH=0` to disable speculative prefetch.

nina: also run multipass emulation (same request repeated with varying batch seeds) to catch non-deterministic drift. I saw seed-dependent drift before with AWQ+FP8.

olivia: good call. I'm running a shadow run with `KV_PREFETCH=0` and `FP8_EMU=1` to emulate fp8 on non-fp8 path. Dumping logits and kv checksums to s3://redwood-triage/fp8-can-2026-03

sam: helpful metrics to capture: per-token logprob mean, top-1 token flip rate, and prefix-match fraction. share eval script snippet?

olivia: eval snippet:
```
python eval.py --canary can-2026-03-20-olivia-03 --metrics top1_flip,token_logprob_mean,prefix_match --out /tmp/canary.json
```

deploy-bot: Canary can-2026-03-20-olivia-03 deployed to h100-eu, l40s-us-west (labels: fp8-experiment)

lee: if emulation reduces delta on l40s, kernel tiling is likely culprit. If not, check accumulation rounding (mantissa alignment) between kernels.

nina: as a stopgap, add a routing policy to prefer h100 for long-seq requests and fall back to int8-AWQ on l40s for user-facing traffic. We'll keep fp8 for short context workloads.

olivia: plan: 1) run multipass emu + KV_PREFETCH off 2) compare per-prompt deltas 3) enable shadow traffic at 5% with routing rule 4) if regression persists, roll FP8 kernel back on l40s and keep canary on h100 only. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml. @sam @lee :eyes:

sam: ack. will provision shadow capacity and add logs for kv checksums.

lee: I'll add a small kernel test to our smoke suite that runs 1k-step longprefix cases on l40s emulation every deploy.

nina: capture random seeds and commit the exact model artifact hash to canary metadata so we can bisect.

olivia: added metadata: model_hash=sha256:deadbeef... , seed=20260320. uploading triage notes to https://redwood.internal/triage/fp8-can-2026-03

sam: :thumbsup:

olivia: updating thread with results in ~2h.
